title: Operator-escrowed gradual-enactment for Optimize recommendations with telemetry sentinel
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Implement an operator-escrowed gradual-enactment flow for Optimize suggestions (batching & KV-cache profiles) that combines short simulated validation, a telemetry sentinel, and a human signoff queue to allow safe auto-apply while minimizing manual intervention.
acceptance_criteria: 1) System can apply a recommended config in an escrowed mode where traffic is mirrored and a small fraction is routed to the change. 2) Telemetry sentinel evaluates SLOs (p99 latency, error-rate, token-cost delta, quality regression score) against thresholds and prevents promotion on violation. 3) Operator signoff queue exposed in Console with one-click approve/reject and an audit log entry. 4) Automated rollback is triggered when sentinel breach persists for defined window. 5) End-to-end tests (simulated traffic harness + e2e integration) pass in CI.
design_notes:
- Enactment flow: suggestion -> sandbox apply (mirror + shadow traffic) -> simulated synthetic test -> staged traffic (0.5% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%) with thermostat checks -> operator escrow window -> full promotion.
- Telemetry sentinel evaluates: latency_p99_delta_ms, error_rate_pct, unit_cost_pct_change, eval_quality_score_delta. Each metric has soft/ hard thresholds; soft breaches slow down ramp, hard breach halts and reverts.
- Approval: Console shows a compact diff (before/after config), expected cost delta, recent evals, and a required approver list. Approver action recorded to audit log and triggers next-signal.
- Rollback: Immediate circuit breaker on hard breach; add delayed rollback if regression is intermittent. Provide replayable rollback plan and PR reference.
- Safety knobs: max ramp per customer per day, opt-out label for regulated customers, dry-run retention 48h, and operator-escrow TTL.
implementation_plan: 1) Build sandbox apply endpoint that can shadow requests and capture KV-cache behavior. 2) Integrate with telemetry pipeline to compute delta metrics in near-real-time. 3) Implement ramp controller with ramp plan DSL and thermostat checks. 4) Add approval queue API and Console surface. 5) Wire automated rollback evaluator and rollback runner. 6) Add CI harness with simulated traffic and baseline comparisons. 7) Run internal pilot on non-paying test orgs then limited customer cohort.
test_plan:
- Unit tests for ramp controller and sentinel logic.
- Integration tests: sandbox apply + telemetry ingestion produces expected deltas.
- Synthetic traffic e2e: run 24h smoke with golden traces and ensure rollback triggers on injected latency/error.
- Manual QA: Console approval flow, audit log entries, and operator UX feedback loop.
risk_and_mitigations: Risk: False positives from sentinel may block beneficial cost savings. Mitigation: implement soft thresholds and require consecutive windows before hard halt; provide 're-evaluate' operator action. Risk: KV-cache mismatch in shadow mode. Mitigation: add instrumentation to compare cache hit ratios and fall back to read-only trial mode. Risk: Unauthorized auto-apply. Mitigation: RBAC gating and required approvers for enterprise orgs.
